g.text: The case reports sufficient cash to meet future capital calls.
Payment capacity is a feasibility condition; the investment's value is judged separately.
Source: Case p. 5; Case p. 13, Exhibit 7 ($300m committed to each of Funds II–V); Inputs!C26, C34:C35; 750 ÷ 300 = 2.5. The two charts use independent scales.
